reason: I have heard a version of this before, an hour of my time, a nice write-up, then a bigger invoice, and the last time I paid monthly for a year I got click reports and no work. The fixed price and I will tell you to change a process instead line is better than what the agency said, but better talk is not proof.
objection: An hour of my Monday morning is real money, and I have got no way to know his one-page fix actually turns into booked jobs before I am the one handing over $1,500 to $3,500, plus I have no idea if a Roscoe guy has ever handled a business like mine.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three names of owner-led shops my size that I could actually call, and one who will say what the fix did to their booked jobs in dollars, not clicks.
